dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: A criminal gang has been smuggling cultural relics out of the country recently. Citizens are asked to be vigilant and report suspicious activity.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: If you have any information relevant to our investigation, bring it to Hezhe Post for a generous reward. Those who shelter or condone criminals will be severely punished.
